game.title: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
game.blurb: Open-world delivery and action-adventure from Kojima Productions, released 2025-06-26 (PS5; later on PC). RAWG has no average playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: No StrategyWiki page. deathstranding.fandom.com answers the API with about 72 linked pages (characters, places, vehicles, two numbered orders); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Project Murray" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 3280350 is Death Stranding 2. The state queue thought this game was PS5 only, but it has a Steam release. 30 of 55 Steam achievements are hidden.
